meta.name: Constant approximation · large-factor limit
meta.regime: For every fixed ε > 0, some constant μ(ε) yields μ-SVP on arbitrary Euclidean lattices
meta.rules: For each fixed ε > 0, find a μ(ε)-approximate nonzero vector for some constant μ(ε). Compare c under these quantifiers only. A limiting coefficient is not a fixed-factor exact-SVP bound. Exact algorithms also qualify, and such transferred guarantees are identified in the notes.
